summary: Corrected an inaccurate mechanism premise in my own knowledge entry before it propagated further. The recorded statement said the blocked invocation sends on a nil channel; re-reading the source shows the caller sends on n.propc, which is always non-nil (node.go:525), while the nil-ness lives in the run loop's local gate variable (node.go:344, assigned at 374/377/426, used as the receive case at 386). The correction matters for the claim's boundary: the pending invocation is admitted unmodified as soon as an observed leader change re-arms the receive side, so the harmed interval is 'no observed leader change' (bounded otherwise by the caller's context or node stop) rather than the node's lifetime. The knowledge entry was revised under its existing id with changed_premise and the four recorded affected interpretations, and the latest interpretation was revised to carry the corrected mechanism, the same unchanged evidence indices, and two new explicit limitations (pending-admission and unbounded-context cases are source-derived or seen only in a native dry run, not yet retained) in place of the earlier wording.
